scope: Official-route and authority-function routing for Irish property questions; it does not decide the outcome of an individual dispute.
verified_sources: Tailte Éireann Search and Copy Services
Tailte Éireann Registry of Deeds services
verified_points: Tailte Éireann maintains the Land Register, Registry of Deeds and Registry Map.
LandDirect provides access to Land Register searches and related services.
A mapping search can identify whether property is registered and identify a folio number.
Registry of Deeds searches disclose whether documents have been executed dealing with the transaction; the underlying deeds are needed to assess their substantive effect.
Official routes and access conditions differ between folios, maps, Instruments and Registry of Deeds records.
core_rule: QUESTION FUNCTION → AUTHORITY → OFFICIAL ROUTE → EVIDENCE/PROCEDURE → LIMITATION → NEXT STEP
